title: Pukaari zainab ghareeb roro
body:
Pukaari zainab ghareeb roro, yateem kehte hai log humko
Bataao ya murtaza kahaa'n ho, yateem kehte hai log humko
Na gham me itna rulaao baba, sada tum apni sunaao baaba
kahaa'n sidhaare ho aao baba, yateem kehte hai log humko
<<DIVIDER>>
Sitam hai Ya booturaab kaisa, Hua hai jeena azaab kaisa
Diya hai tum ne qitaab kaisa, yateem kehte hai log humko
Nikal ke turbat se aao amma, hamei'n gale se lagaao amma
Kahaa'n hai baba bataao amma, yateem kehte hai log humko
<<DIVIDER>>
Jahaa'n me ab jeeke kya karei'n hum, Falak ka kis se gila karei'n hum
Kaho kahaa'n tak suna karei'n hum, yateem kehte hai log humko
Ajal ne naana se bhi churdaaya, raha na maa baap ka bhi saaya
Hum aaj kis se kahei'n khudaaya , yateem kehte hai log humko
<<DIVIDER>>
Nikal ke rouze se aao nana, Taras yeteemo'n pa khaao nana
Humei'n gale se lagaao naana, yateem kehte hai log humko
Karei'n jo shoukat yateem naala, hile na kis tarah arshe aala
bayaa'n tha zainab ka shaahe waala, yateem kehte hai log humko
